segments.text: introducing Microsoft Dynamics 365 business Central and its seamless integration with Shopify hi and welcome to Microsoft Dynamics 365 business Central this video highlights some of the benefits of using business Central as the backend of your shopi store business Central is a powerful business management solution

that can help you run your daily operations and do the finances for all your Shopify stores and the brands you sell in them forget about expensive online Commerce Integrations connecting business Central to your Shopify store is easy we'll guide you through the process in just a few steps business Central makes it easy

to keep inventory levels in your Shopify store up to dat and can automatically fulfill orders orders from your Shopify shop flow directly into business Central so you can focus your time on what's important you can manage the details about your products in business Central and decide what to sell in your store

support for multiple locations lets you optimize Warehouse processes to reduce delivery times and address product and business needs for example you might want to use a specific warehouse for handling returns revenue from your store is automatically reflected in business Central you get a 360° view of your financials

expenses and profits and tools for reporting taxes to authorities business Central also integrates with productivity tools for Microsoft Office for example you can use teams to collaborate with colleagues on
orders use Outlook to communicate with customers directly from business Central or use one drive to store manage and share
documents your Shopify store gives your customers great shopping experiences connecting your store to business Central is great for your business thanks for
